ideas.title: Trump Administration's Child Care Funding Freeze: A Deeper Look
ideas.description: Investigate the Trump administration's decision to freeze $10 billion in child care funds and its impact on low-income families and child care providers.
questions: What were the reasons behind the freeze?
How will the freeze affect low-income families and child care providers?
ideas.insight: This story could explore the motivations behind the Trump administration's decision to freeze child care funds and the potential consequences for vulnerable populations.

ideas.title: ICE Officer Involved Shooting: A Pattern of Misconduct?
ideas.description: Investigate the fatal shooting of Renee Good by ICE officer Jonathan Ross and determine whether it was an isolated incident or part of a larger pattern of police misconduct.
questions: What were the circumstances surrounding the shooting?
Is this part of a larger pattern of police misconduct?
ideas.insight: This story could explore the incident and determine whether it was an isolated case or part of a larger pattern of police misconduct or excessive force.
